newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: East Asia unit to build power plant.
newsitem.headline: East Asia unit to build power plant.

text.p: East Asia Power Resources Corp said on Tuesday its unit East Asia Diesel Power Corp (EADPC) had signed a memorandum of agreement with Visayan Electric Co Inc (VECO) to build a 51.1 megawatt power plant in the Philippines.
Assistant corporate secretary Ildebrando Ambrosio told the Philippine Stock Exchange that EADPC will build and operate the power plant in Cebu city for 15 years under a build-operate-transfer scheme.
EADPC will also rehabilitate an existing 20-megawatt power plant of VECO, which is a privately owned electric utility firm. -- Manila newsroom 63 2 8418938 Fax 8176267
